articles.title: Joe Lubin-backed Ethereum treasury firm SharpLink to join the Russel indexes
articles.snippet: The inclusion could attract fresh passive inflows from index-tracking funds, while the firm's stock tanked 95% from its peak over the past year.

articles.title: UK sanctions Huobi and ruble stablecoin issuer in crackdown on Russia crypto networks
articles.snippet: Britain applied banking-style sanctions to crypto exchanges for the first time, requiring U.K. financial firms to freeze funds and trace transactions.

articles.title: Bermuda, the small island nation with huge crypto ambitions
articles.snippet: The government recently announced it would become the world’s first economy to go fully onchain, a move officials believe will bring its people new opportunities.

articles.title: Coinbase’s Base launches AI tool for ChatGPT to manage crypto wallets and DeFi apps
articles.snippet: The product, called Base MCP, connects a user’s Base Account to AI clients such as ChatGPT, Claude and Cursor using the Model Context Protocol (MCP), an emerging standard that allows AI systems to securely interface with external tools and applications.

articles.title: XRPL could close its biggest DeFi gap if new AMM amendment passes
articles.snippet: A draft proposal filed Tuesday would extend the XRP Ledger's native automated market maker with three swappable curve types, giving liquidity providers more efficient ways to deploy capital and closing one of XRPL DeFi's longest-standing gaps.
